verdict.rationale: Justworks is a PEO and payroll product, so international employment through employer-of-record or global payroll is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence only covers US-centric payroll, W-4 withholding, PEO enrollment, PTO and Xero integration. The 'Make a Payment > Domestic' menu path hints at other payment types but does not show that the product can employ people in other countries through EOR or owned-entity global payroll.
